    "N": 722, "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611,
    "U": 722, "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 667, "b": 611, "c": 556, "d": 611, "e": 667, "f": 333, "g": 722,
    "h": 611, "i": 278, "j": 278, "k": 556, "l": 278, "m": 833, "n": 722,

    total = 0
    for ch in text:
        total += widths.get(ch, widths.get("space", 500))
    return total / 1000.0


def pdf_escape(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")

    """Return {obj_id: raw_object_bytes} using the xref table."""
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    if not m:
        raise SystemExit("ERROR: startxref not found")
    # find xref section before startxref
    xref_marker = data.rfind(b"xref", 0, m.start())
    if xref_marker == -1:
        raise SystemExit("ERROR: xref section not found")
    xref_text = data[xref_marker:m.start()].decode("latin-1")
    offsets = {}
    # classic xref: "0 N" then N lines "off gen n/f"
    for line in xref_text.splitlines():
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].isdigit() and parts[1].isdigit():

            continue
        if len(parts) == 3 and parts[2] in ("n", "f"):
            # possibly "off gen n" where gen might not be 00000 in general

    offsets = {}
    for line in xref_text.splitlines():
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) == 3 and parts[2] in ("n", "f"):
            off = int(parts[0])
            gen = parts[1]
            if parts[2] == "n":
                offsets[int(gen)] = off  # placeholder to avoid unused var
                offsets = {}
    # Use the straightforward approach: subsection format "start count"
    lines = xref_text.splitlines()
    i = 0
    offsets = {}
    while i < len(lines):
        parts = lines[i].split()
        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].isdigit() and parts[1].isdigit():
            start = int(parts[0])
            count = int(parts[1])
            i += 1
            for j in range(count):
                eparts = lines[i + j].split()
                if len(eparts) == 3 and eparts[2] == "n":
                    offsets[start + j] = int(eparts[0])
            i += count
        else:
            i += 1
    if not offsets:

    objects = {}
    for oid, off in offsets.items():
        end = data.index(b"endobj", off) + len(b"endobj")

    return objects, offsets

    with open(SRC, "rb") as f:

    ).encode("latin-1")

    content_obj = (
        f"10 0 obj\n<< /Filter [ /FlateDecode ] /Length {len(compressed)} >>\nstream\n"
    ).encode("latin-1") + compressed + b"\nendstream\nendobj\n"

    # ---- Reassemble document ---------------------------------------------
    pages_obj = (
        "7 0 obj\n<<\n/Count 2 /Kids [ 4 0 R 9 0 R ] /Type /Pages\n>>\nendobj\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.3\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    new_offsets = {}
    for oid in sorted(objects.keys()):
        new_offsets[oid] = len(out)
        if oid == 7:
            out += pages_obj
        else:
            out += objects[oid] + b"\n"
    new_offsets[9] = len(out)
    out += cover_obj
    new_offsets[10] = len(out)
    out += content_obj

    xref_offset = len(out)
    size = 11  # objects 0..10
    out += b"xref\n"
    out += f"0 {size}\n".encode()
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for oid in range(1, size):
        out += f"{new_offsets[oid]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    out += (
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {size} /Root 5 0 R /Info 6 0 R >>\n"
        f"startxref\n{xref_offset}\n%%EOF\n"
    ).encode()

    with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(bytes(out))
    print(f"Wrote {OUT} ({len(out)} bytes)")

    # ---- Self-validation ---------------------------------------------------
    validate(OUT, new_offsets, xref_offset)


def validate(path, offsets, xref_offset):
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        d = f.read()
    assert d.startswith(b"%PDF-1.3"), "bad header"
    assert d.rstrip().endswith(b"%%EOF"), "missing EOF"
    # every xref offset must point at the right object
    for oid, off in offsets.items():
        assert d[off:off + 4] == b"%d 0 "% oid or d[off:off + 3] == b"%d 0"% oid, \

    # check xref trailer

    # verify embedded stream Length values are consistent
    for m in re.finditer(rb"(\d+) 0 obj\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*stream\r?\n(.*?)endstream", d, re.S):

            lm = re.search(rb"/Length (\d+)", header)
            if lm:

                actual = len(m.group(3))
                assert declared == actual, f"Length mismatch in object {oid}: {declared} vs {actual}"

    assert m, "cover content stream not found"
    declared = int(re.search(rb"/Length (\d+)", m.group(1)).group(1))
    assert declared == len(m.group(2)), "cover stream length mismatch"
    plain = zlib.decompress(m.group(2)).decode("latin-1")
    assert "Annual Financial Report" in plain, "title missing from cover stream"
    print("Validation passed: cover stream contains:", repr(plain.splitlines()[0]))
    print("Page count now:", 2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
